violation_type.title: Responsibilities of  Caregivers -Treat Children with Courtesy, Respect, Acceptance, Patience (26 TAC §747.1501(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of  Caregivers -Treat Children with Courtesy, Respect, Acceptance, Patience
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined that a child in care was not treated with patience when the caregiver used a form of prohibited punishment after a child threw their food during lunch time.

finding_variants.text: It was determined that a child in care was not treated with patience when the caregiver used a form of prohibited punishment after a child threw their food during lunch time.
Caregiver did not utilize good judgement and patience when she grabbed a child by the neck to stop him from going to another child's mat.
